blocks.text: The standard tree models (`TreeStore` and `ListStore`) derive from `TreeSortable`, so they offer sorting functionality. For instance, call set_sort_column(), to sort the model by the specified column. Or supply a callback function to set_sort_func() to implement a more complicated sorting algorithm.
blocks.zh: 标准树模型（TreeStore和ListStore）派生自TreeSortable，因此它们提供了排序功能。例如，调用set_sort_column()按指定的列对模型进行排序。或者向set_sort_func()提供一个回调函数以实现更复杂的排序算法。

blocks.text: Independently sorted views of the same model

The `TreeView` already allows you to show the same `TreeModel`
in two `TreeView` widgets. If you need one of these TreeViews to sort the model
differently than the other then you should use a `TreeModelSort` instead of just,
for instance, Gtk::TreeViewColumn::set_sort_column().
